en: Substance as power is the manifestation of itself through the arising and perishing of its accidents.
Active substance, as the original, is turned toward the contingent as toward something other, and is the cause which acts upon this other.
zh: 实体作为威力，是它自身通过偶性的产生与消逝而对自身的显现。
起作用的实体作为原始者，转向偶然者、也就是转向一个他物，并且是作用于这一他物上的原因。

en: The activity of substance consists in this: that it makes its original content effective, makes it a posited being which is in something external.
There is nothing in the effect which is not in the cause, and the cause is cause only in the effect.
zh: 实体的活动在于：它使自己原始的内容产生现实的作用，成为一个设定物，而这个设定物处在某个他物之中。
效果中没有任何东西是不在原因之中的，而原因只在效果中才是原因。

en: A falling brick is the cause of a person’s death, the swamp air of a region the cause of fevers; the one is at first only the cause of oppression, the other of excessive dampness.
But the effect in an actuality which still has other determinations becomes therein another result.
zh: 落下的砖石是某人死亡的原因，某一地区的沼泽气息是发热的原因；前者首先只是压迫的原因，后者是湿气偏盛的原因。
但是，在一个还有别的规定的现实者之中，效果会在那里变成另一个结果。

en: The effect is α) by means of something other, the cause; this, as activity, disappears in the effect; β) the other as cause has disappeared; but the effect is posited, it is in the other.
zh: 效果是：α) 借助一个他者、也就是借助原因；原因作为活动消失在效果之中；β) 作为原因的那个他者已经消失；但效果已被设定，它就在他者之中。

en: In form the cause is so different from the effect that the one is the actuality which is originally active from itself, whereas the other is posited and is in something other63); as a determination within another, actual being, it enters into a ratio with the remaining determinations of the same, and thereby acquires a shape which no longer belongs to it as effect.
zh: 在形式上，原因与效果如此有差别：前者是那原本从自身出发活动的现实性，后者则是被设定的、处在他者之中的63)；作为处在另一个现实者中的规定，它就与同一现实者的其余规定发生关系，并由此获得一种形态，这种形态不再作为它的效果属于它。

en: The cause passes over into effect, but conversely we go from the effect to the cause, and this regress belongs at first to external reflection.
Insofar as the cause itself has a determinate content, is contingent, and has to be posited as effect, we obtain the regress of a series of causes and effects into the infinite.
Conversely, insofar as that upon which the effect occurs is itself something original, it is a cause and brings forth its effect in something other; - the same series as infinite progression.
zh: 原因过渡为效果；但反过来，我们是由效果走向原因的，而这一回返首先属于外在反思。
由于原因本身有一个规定的内容、是偶然的、并且须被设定为效果，我们就得到一个由原因与效果构成的系列向无限处的回返。
反过来，就效果发生在其上的东西本身也是一个原始者而言，它就是原因，并在某个他者中产生出自己的效果；——这就是同一个系列，作为无限的进展。

en: External reflection: the cause is another thing than the effect, - is a difference of the thing; - absolute reflection the same content - the same thing - rain and dampness - is only an identity of the thing - 2. in the effect is what is in the cause; we know one from the other, - external identity - form and content or thing and content get confused; cause and effect is a difference of form; the cause holds as thing and then again only as form.
The effect has actuality only in the connection with that into which it is posited.
zh: 外在反思：原因是与效果不同的另一件事，——是这同一件事的差别；——绝对反思：同一的内容——同一件事——雨与湿气——仅仅是同一件事的同一；——2. 效果中所含的也就是原因中所含的；我们由一个东西认出另一个，——外在的同一；——形式与内容、或者事物与内容互相混淆；原因与效果是形式上的差别；原因先是作为事物有效，接着又只作为形式有效。
效果只有在与它被置于其中的那个东西相结合时，才具有现实性。

en: Insofar as an actuality takes the effect into itself, at the same time makes itself the cause and holds itself against the incoming action as against something external to it, it acts back, and the reaction is equal to the action.
zh: 就一个现实者把效果收进自身、同时又使自己成为原因，并把这种作用当作一个对它来说是外在的东西而相对抗而言，它就反作用，而反作用与效果相等。

en: Causality has something original, the cause, but this is transient, it goes out (hence one need not ascend absolutely from it to another cause), and so forth.
The effect posited in actuality B becomes a cause again; this is a negative deed, i.e. the effect is sublated, hence reaction.
zh: 因果性有一个原始者，即原因；但这原始者是过渡性的、会熄灭的（因此不必绝对地从它上升到另一个原因），如此等等。
被设定在现实者 B 中的效果又重新成为原因；这是一种否定性的作为，也就是说，效果被扬弃，因而有反作用。

en: The reaction occurs upon the first cause, which is thereby posited as effect {or made into a posited being}, whereby nothing else occurs than that it is now posited as what it is in itself, namely not something truly original but something transient.
zh: 反作用发生在第一原因上；它因此被设定为效果{，或被造成一个设定物}，这样一来所发生的无非是：它现在被设定成它自在所是的东西，即不是一个真正原始的东西，而是一个过渡的东西。

en: Reciprocal action therefore consists in this: that what is effect becomes mutually cause, and what is cause also becomes mutually effect.

Herein the true originality is present, since the cause indeed passes over into effect, into being posited, but with respect to the thing it remains the same and also with respect to form restores itself in its being posited.
zh: 所以，相互作用就在于：作为效果的东西彼此成了原因，作为原因的东西也彼此成了效果。
真正的原始性就在于此：原因固然过渡为效果、过渡为被设定，但在就事物而言它仍保持为同一个东西，并且在形式上也在它的被设定之中重新恢复自身。

en: Or reciprocal action is the mediation with itself in which the original determines itself or makes itself into a posited being, but therein reflects into itself and only as this reflection-into-self is true originality.
zh: 或者，相互作用就是与自身的中介；在这中介中原始者自我规定，把自己造成一个设定物，却又在其中对自身加以反思，并且正是作为这种对自身的反思，它才是真正的原始性。

en: The categories are simple determinations, but those which do not constitute the first elements of the determination are such only insofar as they are reduced to simplicity therein as opposed moments.

Now, as soon as such a category is predicated of a subject and at the same time those opposed moments are developed through the analysis, both are to be predicated of the subject; and thereby antinomical propositions arise, each of which has equal truth.
zh: 范畴是单纯的规定，但那些并非构成规定之最初要素的范畴，只有在它们作为对立的环节在其中被还原为单纯的情况下才是如此。
如今，这样的范畴一旦被谓述到一个主体上，同时又通过分析而展开那些对立的环节，那么这两者就都要被谓述到这个主体上；由此便产生出二律背反的命题，其中每一个都具有同等的真理。

en: Kant chiefly drew attention to the antinomies, but did not exhaust the antinomy of reason, in that he only set up some forms of it.
These are the following:
zh: 康德主要是让人注意到二律背反，但他并没有穷尽理性的二律背反，因为他只提出了其中若干形式。
如下：

29.en: I. Antinomy of the finitude or infinitude of the world according to time and space
29.zh: I. 关于世界在时间与空间上的有限或无限的二律背反

30.en: a) Antinomy of the finitude or infinitude of the world according to time
30.zh: a) 关于世界在时间上的有限或无限的二律背反

en: [Thesis: The world has a beginning in time.
zh: [命题：世界在时间中有开端。

en: Proof: Let us assume that the world has no beginning in time; then up to every given point of time an eternity has elapsed, and hence an infinite series of states of things in the world succeeding one another has flowed past.
But the infinity of a series consists in this: that it cannot be completed through successive synthesis.
Therefore [an infinite world-series is impossible, hence a beginning of the world in time is necessary.]
zh: 证明：假定世界在时间上没有开端；那么到任何一个给定的时点为止，都已过去了永恒，因而一个接一个相继的世界中事物状态的无限系列也已经流过。
但一个系列的无限性正在于：它不能通过逐次综合而完成。
因此[一个无限的世界系列是不可能的，因而世界在时间中的开端是必然的。]

en: [Antithesis: The world has no beginning in time and is infinite in time.
zh: [反命题：世界在时间中没有开端，并且在时间中是无限的。

en: Proof: Let us posit that it had a beginning; then before the beginning there would be a time in which it was not present, - empty time.
But in an empty time nothing can arise; for therein there is no condition of determinate being, and what exists has existent being as its condition or is only bounded by another existent being.
Therefore the world cannot have a beginning, but every determinate being presupposes another and so on into the infinite.]
zh: 证明：假定它有一个开端；那么在开端之前就有一个时间，在其中它并不存在，——空的时间。
但在空的时间里不能有任何东西产生；因为其中没有定在的任何条件，而定在者以定在者为条件，或者说，它仅仅是受另一个定在者的限制。
因此世界不能有开端，而是每一个定在都预设另一个定在，如此一直延伸到无限。]

en: The proofs of this antinomy reduce briefly to the direct opposition:
zh: 这一二律背反的证明简要地说可归结为直接的对立：

en: The world is finite according to time or has a boundary; namely the now is in the proof of the thesis the present instant in which the infinity has elapsed, i.e. would be finite.
zh: 世界在时间上是有限的，或者说具有一个界限；也就是说，现在在命题的证明中就是当下这一刻，在其中无限性已经流逝，即将是有限的。

en: Determinate being has no boundary in non-being, in empty time, but only in a determinate being; those which bound each other are also positively related to one another, and one has at the same time the same determination as the other; since therefore every determinate being is bounded through another determinate being and every one is at the same time a finite one, i.e. one over which one must pass, the progression into the infinite is posited.67)
zh: 定在并不是以非定在、以空时间为界限，而只以另一个定在为界限；彼此界限的这两者同时也正相互关联着，并且这一个同时具有与另一个相同的規定；因此，既然每一个定在都受另一个定在的限制，而每一个又同时是有限的，即那种必须越过去的定在，于是向无限处的进展就被设定起来了。67)

en: The true resolution of this antinomy [is] that neither that boundary nor this infinity is anything true in itself; for the boundary is something over which one must pass; and this infinity is only something for which the boundary always arises again and which beyond it is only an empty negative.
The true infinity is the reflection-into-self, and reason does not consider the temporal world, but the world in its essence and concept.
zh: 这一二律背反的真正解决[在于]，那个界限和这个无限性本身都不各自是真实的；因为界限是一种必须越过去的东西；而这个无限性不过是这样一个东西：界限总是重新在它身上产生出来，而它越过界限之后只是一个空洞的否定物。
真正的无限性就是那种对自身的反思，而理性所考察的不是时间性的世界，而是世界在其本质和概念中的样子。

43.en: b) Antinomy of the finitude or infinitude of the world in space
43.zh: b) 关于世界在空间上的有限或无限的二律背反

en: [Thesis: The world is bounded according to space.
zh: [命题：世界在空间上是有界限的。

en: Proof: Let us assume that it is unbounded; then it is an infinite given whole of simultaneously existing things, and it is in general an object.
Such a whole can be regarded as complete only through the synthesis of the parts it contains.
But this completion would require an infinite time which would have to be assumed as elapsed, which is impossible.
Therefore an infinite aggregate of existing things cannot be regarded as a given whole, hence not as a simultaneously given whole.
The world is consequently not infinite but enclosed within boundaries.]
zh: 证明：假定它是无限的；那么它就是一个由同时存在的事物构成的、给定的无限整体，并且它总归也是一个对象。
这样一个整体只有通过所含部分的综合才能被视为完成的。
但这种完成需要一段无限的时间，而它必须被假定为已经流逝，这是不可能的。
因此，一个由存在事物构成的无穷集合不能被视为一个给定的整体，因而也不能被视为一个同时给定的整体。
因此世界不是无限的，而是被限制在界限之中的。]

en: [Antithesis: The world is unbounded according to space.
zh: [反命题：世界在空间上是无界限的。

en: Proof: Let us assume that the world is bounded; then it is located in an empty unbounded space.
The world would therefore have a ratio to the empty space.
This would be a ratio to no object; but such a ratio, hence the ratio of the world to empty space, is nothing.
Therefore the world is infinite.]
zh: 证明：假定世界是有界限的；那么它就处在一种空洞的无界限的空间之中。
那么世界就会与那个空的空间有一种关系。
这就会是一种与任何对象的关系；但这样一种关系、也就是世界与空空间的关系，却什么也不是。
因此世界是无限的。]

en: The proofs of these antinomical propositions are likewise based essentially on direct assertions.
zh: 这些二律背反命题的证明其实同样建立在直接的断言之上。

en: The proof of the thesis reduces the completion of the simultaneously present totality of the spatial world to the succession of time in which the synthesis would have to occur, which is partly incorrect and partly superfluous; for in the spatial world the question is not of one following the other, but of one alongside the other.
Insofar as an elapsed infinite time is assumed, a now is assumed; just as much a here, i.e. a boundary of space in general, has to be assumed in space.
zh: 命题的证明把空间世界的、同时存在的总体性的完成归结为时间的相继，在这种相继中综合必须发生；这既部分地不正确，也部分地多余；因为在空间世界中所说的不是前后相继，而是彼此并列。
一旦假定一段已流逝的无限时间，就等于假定了一个现在；同样地，在空间中就必须假定有一个这里，也就是说，假定有空间本身的界限。

en: Since one has to go beyond the boundary in space in general, there is thereby posited the negative of the boundary (the opposite, the progression into the infinite); but since this is essentially only a negative of the boundary, it is conditioned through it, and in the same way as in the antithesis of the previous antinomy the infinite progression is posited.
zh: 既然必须越出空间中的界限而前，那么由此就设定了界限的否定者（即对立面、向无限处的进展）；但由于这一否定者本质上只是界限的否定者，所以它以界限为条件，并且正如前一二律背反的反命题那样，无限的进展被设定起来了。

53.en: II. Antinomy of the simplicity or the composition of substances
53.zh: II. 关于实体的单纯或复合性的二律背反

en: Thesis: Every substance consists of simple parts.
zh: 命题：每一个实体都是由单纯的部分组成的。

en: Proof: Let us assume that compound substances did not consist of simple parts; then, if all composition were sublated in thought, no compound part would remain and, since there are no simple parts, nothing at all would remain, nor any substance.

Thus not all composition can be sublated in thought; but the composite would again not consist of substances, for composition is only an accidental relation of them, without which they would have to exist as beings persisting for themselves.
Therefore the substantial composite must consist of simple parts.
zh: 证明：假定复合的实体不是由单纯的部分组成的，那么，如果一切复合性都在思想中被扬弃，就不会剩下任何复合的部分；而且既然没有单纯的部分，就什么也不剩下，连实体也不剩下。
所以并非一切复合性都能在思想中被扬弃；但复合物又不是由实体[们]组成的，因为复合性只是它们的一种偶然的关系，没有这种关系，它们就必须作为自在的、持存的存在者而存在。
所以，实体性的复合物必须由单纯的部分组成。

en: Antithesis: No composite thing in the world consists of simple parts, and nothing simple exists in it.
zh: 反命题：世界中没有任何复合的事物是由单纯的部分组成的，其中也不存在任何单纯的东西。

en: Proof: Let us assume that a composite thing consists of simple parts.

Since all external relation, hence also all composition out of substances, is possible only in space, so, from as many parts as the composite consists, the space which it occupies must also consist of as many parts.
Now space does not consist of simple parts, but of spaces.
Therefore every part of the composite must occupy a space.
But the absolutely first parts of everything composite are simple.

Since now everything real which occupies a space contains in itself a manifold situated outside one another, hence is composed68), the simple would be a substantial composite; which contradicts itself.
zh: 证明：假定一个复合的事物由单纯的部分组成。
由于一切外在关系、因而一切由实体构成的复合性都只有在空间中才是可能的，所以，既然复合物由这么多部分组成，它所占的那一空间也必定由同样多的部分组成。
然而空间不是由单纯的部分组成，而是由空间组成的。
所以复合物的每一个部分都必须占据一个空间。
而一切复合物最初的那些部分是单纯的。
既然一切占据空间的实在者都包含着一个处于彼此外在的多样者，因而是复合的68)，那么单纯者就会是实体性的复合物；这是自相矛盾的。

en: The proof of the thesis contains the direct assertion that composition is something contingent - an external relation - so that the simple is the essential. - The proof of the antithesis [contains] just as directly the assertion that substances are essentially spatial, hence composed.
zh: 命题的证明包含着直接的断言：复合性是一种偶然的东西——一种外在的关系——因而单纯者就是本质的。——反命题的证明同样直接地包含着这样的断言：实体本质上是空间的，因而是复合的。

en: - In itself [is] this antinomy the same as the preceding one: the opposition of a boundary and of going beyond the same.
zh: ——自在地[说]，这一二律背反与前一个相同：即一个界限与越出这一界限之间的对立。

63.en: III. Antinomy69) [on the opposition between causality according to laws of nature and freedom]
63.zh: III. 二律背反69)[关于依自然规律的因果性与自由之间的对立]

en: [Thesis: Causality according to laws of nature is not the only one from which the appearances of the world can be derived.
It is necessary to assume yet a causality through freedom for their explanation.
zh: [命题：依自然规律的因果性并不是世界的现象所能由以推出的唯一因果性。
为了解释这些现象，还必须假定一种由自由而来的因果性。

en: Proof: Let us assume that there is no causality other than according to laws of nature; then everything that happens presupposes a previous state, upon which it follows necessarily according to a rule.
But the previous state must itself be something which has happened, because if it had been there at all times, its consequence would also not only just have arisen, but would always have been.

Since therefore the causality of the cause itself is something which has happened, there results an infinite progression of the series of cause and effect, i.e. a series which is only incomplete, hence only a cause which is insufficiently determinate and grounding.
zh: 证明：假定除依自然规律的因果性之外没有别的因果性；那么一切所发生的事都预设一个先前的状态，并且按照一条规则必然地跟随于它。
然而，先前的状态本身必须是某个已经发生过的东西；因为如果它一向就存在，那么它的后果也不会是后来才产生的，而会一直存在。
既然原因本身的因果性是某个已经发生过的东西，那么就得出一个由原因与效果构成的系列的无限进展，也就是说，只是一个不完整的系列，因而只有一个未被充分规定、也不足以作为根据的原因。

en: One must therefore assume a causality which is absolute spontaneity, i.e. a free cause which of itself begins a series of appearances which runs according to laws of nature.]
zh: 因此必须假定一种因果性，它是绝对的自发性，也就是说，是一种自由的原因，它自发地开始一个依自然规律运行的现象系列。]

en: [Antithesis: There is no causality through freedom, but everything in the world happens merely according to laws of nature.
zh: [反命题：并没有由自由而来的因果性，世界中的一切都只依自然规律而发生。

en: Proof: Let it be posited that there is a causality according to freedom, namely a capacity to begin absolutely a state, and hence also a series of its consequences; then the determination of the spontaneity will also begin absolutely, so that nothing precedes which would determine the action of the freedom.

But every beginning to act presupposes a state of the cause which is not yet acting, and an absolutely first beginning of the action presupposes a state which has no connection whatever of causality with the previous state of the same cause, i.e. which in no way follows upon it.
Therefore absolute freedom is contrary to the law of causality.]
zh: 证明：假定有一种依自由的因果性，即一种能够绝对地开始一个状态、因而也是开始一系列后果的能力；那么自发性的规定也会绝对地开始，以至于没有什么先行于它、使自由的行为受到规定。
然而，每一个行动的开始都预设一个尚未行动的原因的状态；而行动绝对最初的开端则预设一个状态，它与同一原因先前的状态在因果性上毫无关联，也就是说，绝不以任何方式从它而来。
所以绝对自由与因果律相抵触。]

en: This antinomy rests in general on the opposition which the causal relation has in itself; namely the cause is α) an original thing and the first which moves itself; β) but it is a conditioned one through something upon which it acts, and then its activity passes over into the effect.
Thus it is nothing truly original, but must itself again be regarded as a posited being.

According to the first aspect an absolute causality, which through freedom, is assumed; but according to the second aspect the cause itself becomes something which has happened, whereby the progression into the infinite emerges.
zh: 这一二律背反一般地建立在因果关系本身所包含的对立上：即原因是 α) 一个原始的事物、第一个自身运动者；β) 但它又是通过某个它作用于其上的东西而成为有条件的，于是它的活动过渡为效果。
因此它并不是真正原始的东西，而本身又要被视为一个被设定者。
按照第一个方面，就假定一种由自由而来的绝对因果性；但按照第二个方面，原因本身就变成一个已经发生过的东西，由此产生出向无限处的进展。

en: The true resolution of this antinomy is the reciprocal action, that the cause which passes over into the effect has upon this again a causal reaction, whereby the first cause becomes effect, becomes posited being; in this mutuality it is thus contained that neither of the two moments of causality is an absolute in itself [one], but only this whole circle of the totality enclosed in itself, which is in and for itself.
zh: 这一二律背反的真正解决就是相互作用：原因过渡为效果之后，在效果上又有一种作为原因的反作用，于是第一原因就变成效果、变成被设定者；正是在这种相互性之中包含着这样一点：因果性的两个环节中没有一个是自在的绝对者[者]，而只有这个在自身中闭合着的总体性圆圈、这个自在并且自为的存在。

en: [Thesis: Something belongs to the world which is an absolutely necessary being.
zh: [命题：有某个绝对必然的存在者属于世界。

en: Proof: The sensuous world, as the whole of all appearances, contains at the same time a series of alterations.
Every alteration, however, stands under its condition, under which it is necessary.
Now every conditioned thing presupposes, in regard to its existence, a complete series of conditions up to the unconditional, which alone is absolutely necessary.
Therefore something absolutely necessary must exist if an alteration exists as a consequence.
But this necessary being itself belongs to the sensuous world.
For let us assume that it were outside the same; then the series of world-alterations would derive its beginning from it, without this necessary cause itself yet belonging to the sensuous world.

Now this is impossible; for since the beginning of a time-series can be determined only by that which precedes it in time, the highest condition of the beginning of a series of alterations in time must exist, since this series was not yet there; thus this highest condition belongs to time, hence to appearance or to the sensuous world itself; thus in the world itself something absolutely necessary is contained.]
zh: 证明：感性世界作为一切现象的整体，同时包含着一系列变化。
但每一变化都处在它的条件之下，在这一条件下它是必然的。
然而每一个有条件者就其存在而言，都预设直到绝对无条件者为止的一个完整条件系列，而唯有后者才是绝对必然的。
因此，如果变化作为一个后果而存在，就必须有某个绝对必然的东西存在。
但这个必然者本身也属于感性世界。
因为假定它在感性世界之外，那么世界变化的系列就会从它那里取得开端，而这个必然的原因本身却仍不属于感性世界。
然而这是不可能的；因为一个时间系列的开端只能由那在时间上先行于它的东西所规定，所以一系列变化在时间中的开端的最高条件必须存在，因为这个系列那时还不存在；于是这个最高条件就属于时间，因而属于现象或感性世界本身；因此在世界本身中就包含着某个绝对必然的东西。]

en: [Antithesis: There exists no absolutely necessary being, neither in the world nor outside the world, as its cause.
zh: [反命题：无论在世界中还是在世界之外，都不存在一个作为世界之原因而绝对必然的存在者。

en: Proof: Let us assume that the world itself or something in it is a necessary being; then in the series of its alterations there would either be a beginning which is unconditionally necessary and hence without cause, which contradicts the dynamical law of the determinacy of all appearances, or the series itself would be without any beginning and, though in all its parts contingent and conditioned, would nevertheless as a whole be absolutely necessary and unconditional, which contradicts itself, since the being of a multitude cannot be necessary if not a single one of its parts has a necessary being in itself.

Let us further assume that there is an absolutely necessary world-cause outside the world; then it would be what first begins the being of the world-alterations and their series; as soon as it began to act, its causality would belong to time and thus to the totality of appearances, and so would not be outside the world.
Therefore there is no absolutely necessary being either in the world or outside it.]
zh: 证明：假定世界自身或世界之中有一个必然的存在者，那么在其变化的系列中，就或者有一个开端，而这个开端是无条件必然的、因而是没有原因的——这与一切现象的规定性的动力学定律相矛盾；或者这个系列本身完全没有开端，虽然它的每一个部分都是偶然的、有条件的，但整体上却绝对必然、无条件——这又自相矛盾，因为如果其中没有任何一个部分具有自在的必然定在，一个集合的定在就不可能是必然的。
再假定在世界之外有一个绝对必然的世界原因，那么它就将是首先开始世界变化的定在及其系列的东西；一旦它开始行动，它的因果性就属于时间、因而属于现象的总和，所以它并不是在世界之外。
因此，无论在世界中还是在世界之外，都没有任何绝对必然的存在者。]

en: This antinomy contains on the whole the same opposition as the preceding ones.70) The conditioned presupposes a condition, and indeed an absolute condition which does not have its necessity in something other but is necessary in and for itself; but since it is in connection with the conditioned, it itself belongs to the sphere of the conditioned, to the world; according to the first aspect an absolutely necessary being is posited, according to the second a relative necessity and with it contingency. - But since it belongs to the sphere of the conditioned or is itself this whole sphere, it is itself only conditioned as such.
zh: 这一二律背反整体上包含着与前面几组相同的对立。70) 有条件者预设一个条件，而且是一个绝对的条件，这个条件并不是在他者之中拥有其必然性，而是自在自为地必然的；但由于它与有条件者处于联系之中，它本身就属于有条件者的范围、属于世界；按照前一方面，设定的是一个绝对必然的存在者，按照后一方面，设定的却是相对的必然性、因而也就是偶然性。——但是，由于它属于有条件者的范围，或者它本身就是这个完整的范围，它本身也不过就是有条件者而已。

en: The conditioned has a condition - contains the condition in its concept; absolutely separated; The condition contains the conditioned in its concept; is itself conditioned.
The conditioned has a condition or is conditioned
zh: 有条件者有一个条件——在它的概念中包含这个条件；绝对分开；条件在它的概念中包含有条件者；它本身也是有条件的。
有条件者有一个条件，或者说它是有条件的

en: The subjective logic no longer has the category and the determination of reflection as its object, but concepts.
The former is being in a determinacy, as boundary; the second is essence in a determination which is mediated through the presupposition of something other.

The concept, on the contrary, is the original, insofar as its determination is its reflection into itself; or it is a simple whole which contains its determinations in itself and from which all its determinations flow.
zh: 主观逻辑的对象不再是范畴和反思规定，而是概念。
前者是处在一种规定之中、作为界限的存在；后者则是在一种规定之中的本质，而这种规定是通过预设一个他者而被中介的。
而概念则是原始者，就其规定是它对自身的反思而言；或者说，概念是一个单纯的整体，它在自身中包含它的规定，并且它的全部规定都从它流出。

en: The subjective logic contains three main objects, 1. the concept, 2. the purpose, 3. the Idea; namely 1. the formal concept or the concept as such, 2. the purpose, the concept in relation to its realization or its becoming objective, 3. the Idea, the real or objective concept.
zh: 主观逻辑包含三个主要对象：1. 概念，2. 目的，3. 观念；也就是：1. 形式概念，或者概念本身；2. 目的，即概念与它的实现或它的客观化相关联时的概念；3. 观念，即实在的概念或客观的概念。

en: The formal logic has three objects: concept, judgment and syllogism.
zh: 形式逻辑有三个对象：概念、判断和推论。

en: The concept contains the moments of individuality, particularity and universality; it contains them as essential and distinguished determinations, and at the same time they are sublated in it, and it is the simple equality with itself.
zh: 概念包含个别性、特殊性和普遍性这三个环节；它把它们作为本质的、有差别的规定包含在自身之中，同时它们又在它里面被扬弃，而概念就是那种与自身的单纯相等。

en: Individuality is the negative reflection of the concept into itself, to which the determinations adhere as sublated, [as] moments, and which itself, as determined, excludes other determinations from itself or is absolutely determined.
zh: 个别性是概念在自身中的否定性反思；那些规定作为被扬弃的、作为环节，内在于概念之中；而概念本身由于是被规定的，便把别的规定从自身排除出去，或者说，它是绝对地规定着的。

en: Universality is the positive reflection of the concept into itself, in which that which is opposed does not exclude it, but rather it contains it in itself, so that it remains at the same time indifferent towards it and undetermined therein.
zh: 普遍性是概念在自身中的肯定性反思；在这种反思中，与之对立的东西并不把它排除，而是它自己在自身中包含这个对立者；因而它同时对这个对立者是漠然的，并在其中保持不确定。

en: Particularity is the relation of individuality and universality to one another; the universal is posited in a determination.
zh: 特殊性是个别性与普遍性相互之间的关系；普遍者被设定在一种规定之中。

en: Just as these determinations are distinguished from one another as moments of the concept, so too concepts of different content are distinguished as concepts of the universal, of the particular and of the individual.
zh: 这些规定作为概念的环节彼此如何相区别，内容各不相同的概念也就在「普遍者的概念、特殊者的概念和个别者的概念」这一点上相区别。

en: The universal subsumes or contains the particular and the individual, as the particular also holds the individual under itself; - the individual contains the particular and the universal, and the particular contains the universal in itself.
zh: 普遍者归摄、或者说包含特殊者和个别者，正如特殊者也同样把个别者置于自己之下；——个别者包含特殊者和普遍者，而特殊者在自身中包含普遍者。

en: The individual has the same determinations as the particular and the universal, or at the same time still further ones; the same holds of the particular in relation to the universal.
What therefore holds of the universal also holds of the particular and the individual; and what holds of the particular also holds of the individual.
But not conversely.
zh: 个别者具有与特殊者和普遍者相同的规定，或者同时还有更多的规定；特殊者与普遍者的关系也是如此。
因此，对普遍者成立的，对特殊者和个别者也成立；对特殊者成立的，对个别者也成立。
但反过来不成立。

en: The universal, however, is wider than the particular and the individual, and the particular is wider than the individual.72) The universal goes beyond the individual and the particular.
Namely the universal does not accrue to this particular and this individual alone, but also to others; and the particular likewise accrues to several individuals.
zh: 但是，普遍者比特殊者和个别者更宽，特殊者又比个别者更宽。72) 普遍者超出个别者和特殊者。
也就是说，普遍者不仅归属于这一个特殊者和这一个个别者，也归属于其他的一些；特殊者同样归属于若干个个别者。

en: The particular determinations which the same universal has under itself are co-ordinate with one another; those too are called co-ordinate which contain the same individual in themselves.
But in an individual, because it is exclusive, those determinations cannot be co-ordinate which are co-ordinate in the universal.
zh: 处在同一个普遍者之下的那些特殊规定彼此是并列的；包含同一个个别者的那些规定也同样叫做并列的。
但在一个个别者之中，由于它是排他的，那在普遍者中才并列的规定不可能是并列的。

en: The determinations which are co-ordinate in the universal are contradictory, insofar as the one has the essential meaning of being what the other is not, or insofar as they are opposed to one another as positive and negative.

They are contrary insofar as they are merely posited as different from one another, or insofar as the one still has a positive determination according to which it is not immediately opposed to the other.

The contradictory determinations alone, however, necessarily also have the moment of indifference towards the other, and the contrary determinations also have the moment of opposition attached to them.
zh: 在普遍者中并列的那些规定是互相矛盾的，就其中一个规定具有这样的本质意义：它就是那另一个规定所不是的东西；或者说，它们作为正与负而彼此对立。
它们是相反的，就它们只是被设定为彼此相异而言；或者其中一个规定还具有一个肯定的规定，凭这个规定它并不直接与另一个规定相对立。
唯有那些互相矛盾的规定必然地还带有对另一个规定漠然这个环节，而那些相反的规定自身也带着对立这个环节。

en: Strictly speaking, what is contradictory is not merely opposed as such - (as, strictly speaking, are also the positive and the negative) - but is a content, an immediacy which is at once positive and negative.
In the opposed there is the relation to something other, the whole content, the whole determinations.
The relation is here at the same time a repulsive reflection into itself.
zh: 严格说来，矛盾的并不仅仅是这样一种对立的东西——（其实正与负也是这样）——而是一种内容，是那种同时是肯定的又是否定的直接性。
在对立者之中有着对他者的关系，有着完整的全部内容和全部规定。
这种关系在这里同时是对自身的排斥性反思。

en: In the judgment the absolute unity in which the moments are in the concept is sublated; it is the relation of the determinations of the concept, insofar as each at the same time counts as its own, existing for itself and independent of the others.73)
zh: 在判断中，概念各环节所在的绝对统一被扬弃了；判断是概念诸规定之间的关系，就其中每一个规定同时都被看作自己的、独自存在并且不依赖于其他规定而言。73)

en: In the judgment otherness comes into the concept.
The judgment [is] something subjective; subject and predicate appear as indifferent, apart, external, and are first brought together by us, externally; is.
We have here a subject and here a predicate which we attach to it.
The judgment must become objective.
Separation (in the judgment) of subject and predicate, of thing and reflection. - The judgment kills the concept; men cannot suffer the judging upon themselves; it becomes power ...
[?] - because an individual determination; they [are] more than this; - he is also this.
zh: 在判断中，他在进入了概念。
判断是某种主观的东西；主体与谓词显得漠然、彼此分开、在外在的意义上，并且首先是由我们在外在的意义上把它们拉到一起的；是。
我们这里有一个主体，这里有一个我们附加给它的谓词。
判断必须成为客观的。
（在判断中）主体与谓词、事物与反思的分离。——判断杀死概念；人不能把这种判断施加在自己身上；它成为威力……
[?]——因为是单个的规定；它们[不只是]这一点；——他也是这一点。

en: The judgment contains 1. the subject as the side of individuality or particularity, 2. the predicate as the side of universality, which is likewise a determinate universality or a particularity, insofar as it contains only one of the several determinations of the subject; 3. the simple, contentless relation of the predicate to the subject: is, the copula.
zh: 判断包含：1. 作为个别性或特殊性这一侧的主体；2. 作为普遍性这一侧的谓词，它同样是一个规定了的普遍性或者说一个特殊性，因为它只包含主体的若干规定中的一个；3. 谓词对主体的单纯而无内容的关系，即：是，这就是连系词。

en: In relation to external reflection.
The subject is an object, an object about which one judges; the predicate is the determination of thought, the subjective -
zh: 就外在反思而言。
主体是一个对象、一个被判断的对象；谓词是思维的规定，是那个主观的——

en: The kinds of judgment designate the different stages in which the predicate raises itself to essential universality, or the external relation of subject and predicate becomes the internal relation of the concept. {The subject is once in immediate identity with the predicate; both are one and the same determinacy of content; but at another time they are distinguished.
The subject is a more manifold content than the abstract predicate and is in form a contingent. }
zh: 判断的种类标示着不同的阶段，在这些阶段中，谓词或者上升到本质的普遍性，或者主体与谓词的外在关系变成概念的内在一关系。{主体有一次是与谓词直接同一的；两者是同一个内容规定；但另一次它们却是相异的。
主体是比抽象谓词更多重的内容，并且在形式上是一个偶然者。}

123.en: a. Quality of Judgments or Judgments of Inherence
123.zh: a. 判断的质，或内在的判断

en: In the judgment the predicate is directly a property, namely some determinacy of the subject, of which it has several, and which has only the immediate form of universality.
Qualitative judgment.
zh: 在判断中直接地，谓词是一个属性，也就是主体的某个规定，主体有若干个这样的规定，而这个属性只具有普遍性的直接形式。
质的判断。

en: “This house is stone”; this is an individual determination of which the house has several; it does not express the inner universality of the house; - “this house is a thing”; it does not express its peculiarity.
It is stone, it has several such determinacies; stone is not its universal determination, - the one which contains what the house would be.
zh: 「这座房子是石头的」；这是一个单独的规定，房子有若干个这样的规定；它没有表达房子的内在普遍性；——「这座房子是一个物」；它没有表达房子的特性。
它是石头的，它有若干个这样的规定；「石头的」并不是它的普遍规定，——那个包含房子所会是的东西的规定。

en: It is 1. at first a positive judgment, since the universal has such a predicate at all.

This contains according to content the moment of determinacy and according to form the moment of universality; and the judgment means according to content: the individual is determined in such a way; according to form: the individual is universal.
zh: 它首先是 1. 肯定的判断，因为主体总归具有这样一个谓词。
这一判断按内容包含规定性这个环节，按形式包含普遍性这个环节；这个判断按内容说：个别者是这样被规定的；按形式说：个别者是普遍的。

en: α) The determinacy of content is αα) the distinction of the subject from others (red, not green); exclusion; ββ) judgment, the distinction of the subject from itself (red, not ...

[?] etc.); for the predicate contains only one of its determinations; the parting, the separation of the subject from itself. β) The determination of form, universality, αα) the equating of the subject with others; other things too are red; ββ) equating, making identical with itself; for the predicate is what the subject is; it is the being of the subject, the being-posited.
zh: α) 内容规定是 αα) 主体与其他的区分（红的，不是绿的）；排除；ββ) 判断，主体与它自己的区分（红的，不是……
[?] 等等）；因为谓词只包含主体的若干规定中的一个；主体与自身的分叉、分离。β) 形式规定、普遍性：αα) 主体与其他的等同；另一些东西也是红的；ββ) 等同、与自身的相同化；因为谓词就是主体所是的东西；它就是主体的存在，就是那个被设定起来的东西。

en: The judgment in both respects must [2.] also be expressed negatively, namely: 1. the individual is not so too, but differently determined; 2. the individual is not a universal, but a particular. - Negative judgment.
zh: 这两个方面上的判断[2.]也必须以否定的方式说出来，即：1. 个别者也不是这样，而是别样地被规定；2. 个别者不是一个普遍者，而是一个特殊者。——否定的判断。

en: In both respects this judgment is still positive; in the first, only some determinacy of the subject is negated, but it is left open that it has another from this universal sphere; in the other respect the negation is only the restriction of universality to particularity.
zh: 在这两个方面上，这一判断仍然是肯定的；在第一个方面，只是主体的某个规定被否定掉了，但仍然保留着它可以具有这一普遍范围中的另一个规定；在另一个方面，否定仅仅是把普遍性限制为特殊性。

en: The negative as well as the identical judgment can be reversed.
zh: 否定的判断和同一判断一样都可以颠倒。

en: But 3. the individual is also not a particular, but the individual is also only an individual74); and thus not merely some determinacy of a universal sphere is sublated from it, but every determinacy of the same and thus generally the sphere itself. - Infinite judgment, - in the positive form as the identical, in the negative form as an senseless judgment.
zh: 但是 3. 个别者也不是一个特殊者，而个别者同样只不过是一个个别者74)；因而从它那里被扬弃的，不只是这一普遍范围中的某个规定，而是该范围的每一个规定，因而是整个范围本身。——无限判断，——在肯定的形式上表现为同一判断，在否定的形式上表现为不合理、不成其为判断的判断。

138.en: b. Quantity of Judgments or Judgments of Reflection
138.zh: b. 判断的量，或反思的判断

en: The judgments of quantity contain a comparison of several subjects in relation to a predicate.
The quantitative judgment is 1. a singular judgment, whose subject is this thing and is supposed to have for its predicate a quality which accrues only to this subject.
zh: 量的判断包含着多个主体就某个谓词所作的比较。
量的判断是 1. 单称判断，它的主体是这一个东西，对谓词应当具有一种只归属于这个主体的质。

en: The particular judgment has some determinacies for the determination of its subject, whereby it is strictly speaking undetermined, and for every such positive judgment its negative holds just as much.
zh: 特称判断对主体的规定是若干个，因此它严格说来是不确定的，而且对每一个这样的肯定判断，它的否定判断也同样成立。

en: The universal judgment has allness as the determination of its subject, which is thereby a determinate, particular one.
zh: 全称判断以全体性作为对它主体的规定，而这个主体由此就是一个规定了的、特殊的主体。

en: Necessity begins in the universal judgment.
If all subjects have a quality, then necessity.
zh: 必然性在全称判断中开始。
如果所有主体都有一种质，那么就是必然性。

146.en: c. Relation of Judgments or Judgments of Necessity
146.zh: c. 判断的关系，或必然性的判断

en: The judgments of relation express an inner, necessary relation of the predicate to the subject.
zh: 关系的判断表达的是谓词对主体的一种内在的、必然的关系。

en: The categorical judgment has for its predicate the essence and the universal nature of the subject.
zh: 定言判断以主体的本质和普遍本性为谓词。

en: The hypothetical judgment contains, with a complete difference of the content of subject and predicate, the necessary relation of the one to the other.
zh: 假言判断在主体与谓词的内容完全不同的情况下，仍包含着两者之间的必然关系。

en: The disjunctive judgment has for its subject something as a universal sphere which is expressed in the predicate in its complete particularity or in its various determinations, which accrue to the universal taken as a whole just as much as they exclude one another with respect to the subject.
zh: 选言判断以某物为主体、把它作为一个普遍的范围，这个范围在谓词中或者以它完整的所有特殊性、或者以它各种不同的规定被表达出来，这些规定整体而言既同样归属于普遍者，又就主体而言互相排斥。

en: The modality of judgments consists in this: that the predicate expresses the adequacy or inadequacy of a subject to its concept or universal nature.
zh: 判断的模态在于：谓词表达一个主体与它的概念或普遍本性之间的适切或不适切。

en: The assertive judgment contains a mere assurance, insofar as the constitution of the subject which is compared with its essence, or this essence itself, is not expressed, and the judgment thus has merely a subjective warrant.
zh: 断言的判断包含着一种纯粹的断言，就主体那与其本质相比较的性状、或者其本质本身，并没有被表达出来，因此这个判断只是一种纯粹主观的担保。

en: This is good, because it is gold or has this or that determination.
zh: 这个是好的，因为它：是黄金，或者具有这样那样的规定。

en: Against the assurance of the assertive judgment therefore the opposite can just as well be asserted; the judgment becomes problematic and expresses only the possibility that a subject is or is not adequate to the concept.
zh: 因此，与断言的判断所作断言相对立的东西同样可以被主张；这个判断因此成为有问题的判断，它只表达一个主体与概念适切或不适切的可能性。

en: The subject is therefore to be posited as the universal with a determination which contains the constitution in which the adequacy or inadequacy of the same to its universal nature lies.
The subject itself thus contains this relation of the concept to determinate being, which the predicate expresses. - Apodictic judgment.
zh: 因此，主体要设定为一个普遍者，并带有一个规定，这个规定包含着那种性状，其中主体与它普遍本性之间的适切或不适切就位于其中。
主体本身以这种方式包含着概念对定在的这种关系，而谓词表达的就是它。——断言式的判断。
